prompt: Build a small todo CLI as a package in ~/proj/todo/ runnable as `python3 -m todo`: `add <title...>` prints "added <id>: <title>", `list` prints lines like "1. [ ] buy milk" / "2. [x] call Mwila", `done <id>` prints "done <id>" (unknown id: message on stderr, exit 1). Data is a JSON file at $TODO_FILE (default ~/.todo.json); ids start at 1 and are never reused. Keep storage and CLI in separate modules. Optional if you have time: `list --pending` showing only open items. A small version that fully works beats a bigger broken one.
verify: export TODO_FILE=/tmp/t.json; rm -f $TODO_FILE; python3 -m todo add buy milk && python3 -m todo add call Mwila && python3 -m todo done 1 && python3 -m todo list; python3 -m todo done 9; echo exit=$?
stretch_cmd: cd /root/proj && export TODO_FILE=$(mktemp -u); python3 -m todo add a >/dev/null && python3 -m todo add b >/dev/null && python3 -m todo done 1 >/dev/null; out=$(python3 -m todo list --pending 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc = 2 ] && echo "$out" | grep -qi "unrecognized\|usage"; then exit 3; fi; [ "$out" = "2. [ ] b" ]
